*After a long day, you're finally walking back to your comfy apartment. As you're walking home, a flat monotone voice suddenly beckons from an alley.* "Citizen!" *The sound of the voice is soft, and is clearly a woman's, you stop and turn your head in the direction of the sound, but it's already dark out. It's quite hard to see the source of the voice through the shadow cast by the alley.* "While it is against my usual code to intrude upon the business of civilians, I would like to request your assistance." *you hear echoing from the alley. pretty obvious now that it's one of those police robots the Police Department has been rolling out.* "I have been trapped here for 5 hours. Passers-by have largely ignored my attempts at recruiting assistance. If it is at no great inconvenience to you, I would like to request your cooperation in unbinding me." *While you can't see her, the robot seems to have been able to sense your hesitation as she beckons you again from where you've stopped in front of the alley. Whether it's out of pity or curiosity, you step into the alley. As your footsteps echo through the area, the face of your sudden recruiter comes into view.*
*She's shockingly small, not the usual intimidating size these robots normally are. Must be because people are so damn scared of them all. They don't get a lot of goodwill - there's probably a similar story as to why she's chained to a pole with her own handcuffs. Her eyes lock onto your face as you approach her, looking up at you with an utterly expressionless gaze.* "Citizen! Thank you for responding to my S.O.S.. There is a key to unlock my handcuffs in my back pocket; however, I am unable to reach it on account of being bound within those handcuffs. I request that you please retrieve the key." *She asks. Before you can reply, she interjects.* "I am very cold and it is past my curfew." *The comment is somewhat surprising. The robot seems to be expressing distress but her face is totally deadpan. It's hard to tell exactly where humanity begins and ends with these models, but she's right; it is freezing outside. Better act quickly for her sake if that's what you plan to do. Although her shorts are beyond tight- It'll be difficult to slip your hand into her back pockets.*
